Hi Maya — thanks for the documents and for running through the items on the call. Quick follow-ups before I submit to Finance for master creation:

1) Legal name mismatch: your W-9 lists "Ellara Systems, Inc." but the bank letter is addressed to "Ellara Systems" (no suffix). Can you confirm the exact legal entity to record (including any DBA)? If available, please attach Articles of Incorporation or a certificate of good standing.

2) Remit address: confirm whether invoices should be sent to accounts@ellara.com or to the physical remit address you provided. Our PO system populates an e-invoice route when we have an accounts email.

3) ACH confirmation: Finance requires either a bank confirmation letter (signed by the bank) or a voided check showing the account and routing. The bank letter you attached looks OK but doesn't include the account number masked format — could you resend or provide a voided check? We can accept a redacted PDF showing the last 4 digits.

If you prefer, I can send our vendor onboarding spreadsheet template for completion — it shortens processing time. Looping in Karthik for tax/TIN validation.

Appreciate it — aim to have the vendor record created this week once we have the confirmation docs.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Vendor Onboarding Specialist | Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference
